system.description: The Cappadocians have recently Embraced key members of the Venetian Giovanni merchant family. These necromancer-merchants possess a keen insight into what may one night become a legitimate Discipline, and their Embrace encourages its development. Characters with Giovanni Lineage may take and learn the fledgling Discipline of Necromancy as an additional clan Discipline. Giovanni characters may not begin play any lower than 11th generation, nor may they take Prescience or Mad Visions; these peculiarities are curiously absent among Giovanni Cappadocians.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
